prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil fatty acid profiles and minor lipid components including tocopherols can be characterized using HPLC-MS and GC-MS techniques to identify compositional factors affecting oxidative degradation.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-04877","field":"abstract","quote":"Triacylglycerol molecular species were profiled by HPLC-MS in positive ion mode"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-04877","field":"abstract","quote":"Tocopherol and phytosterol contents were minimally affected up to 140 °C"}]},{"text":"Oxidative stability of cold-pressed seed oils can be assessed through peroxide formation measurements and induction period testing to correlate antioxidant composition with shelf-life degradation pathways.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-04871","field":"abstract","quote":"Rancimat induction periods were 2.4–3.8 h for rosehip oil and 4.1–5.9 h"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-04871","field":"abstract","quote":"Correlations between tocopherol content and induction period were moderate"}]},{"text":"Research has demonstrated that tocopherol content in cold-pressed oils shows moderate correlation with oxidative stability, suggesting that both major components and minor antioxidants require profiling to explain degradation mechanisms.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-04871","field":"abstract","quote":"Tocopherol analysis by HPLC-FLD showed α-tocopherol dominating rosehip oil"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-04871","field":"abstract","quote":"Correlations between tocopherol content and induction period were moderate"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has direct expertise in cold-pressed seed oil characterization, tocopherol and lipid profiling using HPLC-MS and GC-MS [SYN-PUB-04877], oxidative stability assessment and induction period testing [SYN-PUB-04871], and prior industry experience with regional cold-pressed oil producers [R0403], making them well-positioned to identify oxidation pathways and recommend process improvements for pumpkin seed oil shelf-life issues."}
